title: Normal-Form Characterization of Adaptivity and Entanglement in Pauli-Based Computation
summary: Pauli-based computation (PBC) is a measurement-based model of quantum computation that samples from output distributions of universal Clifford+$T$ circuits. Here, we provide a normal form (NF) that completely characterizes its adaptive and entanglement structures. These insights unify PBC with one-way quantum computing as dual or `time-reversed' counterparts. We use the NF to advance strategies for distributed computation and investigate magic-state injection rates.
